column1: # Swoop2 nylon rods (joncs), as its own design program computes them
# Source: Laboratori d'envol, LEparagliding output for the Swoop2
# measure: as-computed by the source program
# This is GROUND TRUTH for the rods: the lengths the design's own program
# prints, not a reading of the input file's section 21.
# Two blocs of 25, 50 rods per side: 16.53 m of type 1 and 19.88 m of type 4,
# 36.41 m per side and 72.81 m for both sides, which is the total the program
# Type 1 is a nose rod, ONE piece from the upper surface round the leading
# edge to the lower surface — why an 82.6 cm rod sits on a 209 cm chord whose
# section 21 zones span 12.0-18.5% and 7.0-15.0%. Type 4 is an EXTRADOS rod, a
# batten along the upper surface from 23.5% to 70% of chord.
# Corrected 2026-09-29: this file carried the program's "total length, both
# sides, 72.81 m" line as a 26th rod of bloc 2, 72.81 cm long. That made 51
# rods and 37.14 m, and every figure built on it was wrong.
